spans.text: The last target has been shot down and peace is restored to the beach.
That was unexpected.
As I watch the Dolls inspecting the battlefield, I recall Kalina's promise of a peaceful holiday and feel a sense of déjà vu.
Woe is me, but at least it's over...
Didn't see that coming, did you? I'm gonna show you what I've really got!
...I hope?
You dare challenge me? You've got guts, I'll give you that much at least. TAKE THAT!
Ahahahahaha~!

We've picked a relatively clean section of the beach for our holiday spot, sandwiched in between two clusters of reefs that are easily taller than a person. The commotion seems to be coming from behind them.
Since this morning, the girls have been running around causing a ruckus like birds let out of their cages.
Everyone completely lets themselves loose, probably because it's a hard-earned vacation – they're so relaxed they didn't even notice the fight that just took place over there.
The splashing waves and the sound of merrymaking starkly contrast the tense atmosphere after the recent battle, creating the illusion of two entirely different worlds.
I remember they even brought toys for a water fight...?
Commander, all targets eliminated. That was some brilliant leadership, Commander!
Before I can reply, Serdyukov notices the Dolls who are still completely oblivious.
Look at those little sparrows chirping and having fun.
Sorry, Commander. Their comms module seem to have been deactivated when the emergency hails were issued. Probably because they're playing in the water...
It did happen completely out of the blue, so this isn't exactly a case of dereliction of duty, but we must all remain vigilant while we learn more about our enemy.
Besides, it's not a good thing to lose one's head like that – they probably don't even remember today is Thursday.
Commander, it's Friday today.
Hmm?
Hmm?
Ahem... Scout the surroundings while I call them back.
Serdyukov tactfully catches up with her fellow Dolls and starts venturing deeper into the island.
I watch as they disappear into the distance and let out a sigh. Once I go around the reefs, I see the group of little sparrows gleefully fighting their own "war" on the beach.
Heheheh, I'm gonna pay you back double!
O-only if you catch me~!
The two girls are locked in a chase with pure smiles on their faces, as if they lived in a world with no more strife...
Uh.
I look around to make sure that neither SPAS-12 nor the Damascus steel axe is around and sigh in relief...
I'd better stop thinking about stupid things. I don't want to interrupt them, but this really isn't the time to fool around.
Alright, that's it for today. Assemble over there at once!
Those two are still frolicking.
They haven't turned off their auditory module as well, have they?
Oh, Commander! You're right on time! Come with me!
It's no use to hide! Commencing counterattack~!
Counter what...? Hold on, why are you running towards me?!
As my subordinate, it's your job to sacrifice yourself! I'll remember you!
I didn't agree to being your meat shield...
Dammit! How dare you use Master like that? I won't forgive you! Take this!
Your "this" hit me square in the face!
Wait, what did you put in the water pistol?
Gr G41 and C-MS are so into pushing me around it's practically impossible to reason with them, and I suddenly find myself yanked over to the water.
Commander? I didn't expect you to enjoy such childish games. I guess I'll have to lower my expectations.
Says you, who's holding a water gun yourself?
Listen here, things aren't looking good on that side of the beach. I need you to...
Ahahahahaha!
Please...let me finish!
I've never seen the Commander so lively.
I must document this for future reference! Show me more! More!
I-I'm coming too!
For whatever reason, I seem to have become everyone's target.
Waves and jets of water splash everywhere and have me completely disoriented.
As the attack subsides a little, I finally manage to catch a glimpse of the beach, but I also see a small object flying straight at me...
Smack!
This thing hits me on the forehead like a bullet. Its strong momentum actually knocks me off-balance and I topple backwards.
Oh no! Where did my button go?!
Oh boy.
Before I can even utter this, I'm completely submerged in the cold seawater.
The currents swirl around me and drag my body into the deep.
As I'm still struggling to find my equilibrium, I feel the back of my head hitting something hard, then I lose consciousness...
Commander, we've finished searching the perimeters. Are you still not ready?
...Where's the Commander?
Huh? You're right, Master is gone! The Commander was here just a second ago!
Must be hiding!
Huh? Does the Commander know how to swim?
That doesn't matter because the problem is pretty obvious, don't you think?
The Commander is drowning!
Drowning?!
O-oh no! Master, I'm coming to save you!
I can't let anything happen to my precious subordinate!
Hold on, the waves are getting too strong!
Don't panic and don't rush it! We must keep calm right now!
Hailing all Dolls. Hailing all Dolls!
The Commander is in danger! Please rally at my location!
Oh, they're coming!
So soon? No, those are enemy units!
At a time like this? What awful timing.
We didn't pick up any signals in our recent search though... Anyway, we need to put together a counterattack right away!
Our reinforcements are going to arrive soon! Let's eliminate the immediate threat in the meantime!
